metadata.title: COMPAGENT Streamlined vLLM Refactor (Antigravity Agent Rules)

execution_rules.rule: Run terminal commands sequentially to avoid high local CPU/GPU heat spikes.
Publish an Artifact summary after completing each major architectural phase.
Save useful refactoring pattern learned into the local knowledge base.

subagent.task: Deprecate legacy Docker containers and consolidate file layout into a single vLLM server root.
Collapse Reflexive, Reflective, and Director agent prompts into a unified AWQ quantized model wrapper.
Replace REST HTTP base64 endpoints with high-speed bidirectional binary WebSocket streaming.
Decouple avatar gestures and voice playback loop into background Web Workers.

phase.name: Codebase Audit & Distillation Artifact
phase.instruction: Audit legacy Python services and create an XRLF system prompt embedding spiritual and director logic.
phase.verification: Artifact generated with zero missing system variables.

phase.name: vLLM Inference Core Migration
phase.instruction: Deploy single vLLM server wrapper with AWQ quantization support and speculative decoding.
phase.verification: Terminal test streams initial token in under 50ms.

phase.name: WebSocket Audio/Token Transport
phase.instruction: Establish bi-directional streaming for WebXR inputs and outputs.
phase.verification: WebSocket handles binary audio streaming without frame lag.

phase.name: WebXR Frontend Optimisation
phase.instruction: Offload avatar micro-animations and gesture tag parsing to async Web Workers.
phase.verification: WebXR maintains stable frame rates (72-90 FPS).
